question: How can I configure my SDK to have nested method names like client.admin.users.create() instead of a flat structure?
ground_truth: To configure nested method names in your SDK, you can use the `x-fern-sdk-group-name` extension with multiple values in your OpenAPI specification. For example, to create `client.admin.users.create()`, you would add `x-fern-sdk-group-name: [admin, users]` and `x-fern-sdk-method-name: create` to your endpoint definition. The SDK will preserve the order of group names and automatically handle appropriate casing for each language (camelCase for TypeScript, snake_case for Python, PascalCase for Go, etc.).

metadata.cited_context: If you add more than one `x-fern-sdk-group-name` extension, then the generated SDK will nest group names. The generated SDK method preserves the order of group names. In the example below, Fern will generate a method called `client.users.notifications.send()`: `x-fern-sdk-group-name: - users - notifications x-fern-sdk-method-name: send`
